description: This Java source file defines the class MockACEDevice, which extends MockZigbeeDevice and implements multiple interfaces to simulate a security device with various capabilities such as tamper detection and battery status. It includes methods to simulate arming the system, requesting panel status, and managing tamper and battery states.

classes.name: MockACEDevice
classes.description: A mock implementation of a security device, simulating arm/disarm commands, tamper detection, and battery status for testing purposes.

methods.name: MockACEDevice
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the device with specified parameters, setting up associated clusters.

methods.name: requestArm
methods.description: Simulates user arming the security system with a given access code and arm mode.

methods.name: requestPanelStatus
methods.description: Requests the current panel status, useful for wakeup or polling.

methods.name: isTampered
methods.description: Returns whether the device has been tampered with.

methods.name: setTampered
methods.description: Sets the tampered status of the device.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Checks if the device reports a low battery status.

methods.name: setLowBattery
methods.description: Sets the low battery status of the device.
